sql.process.getAllForCompany: select process.id, process.process_name, company_process.company_id, process.created_by_id, company_process.archived, process.parent_company_id from flow.company_process inner join flow.process on process.id = company_process.process_id where company_id = :companyId and company_process.archived is not true order by process.process_name;
sql.process.get: select p.id, p.process_name, cp.company_id, p.created_by_id, cp.archived, p.parent_company_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(processSteps))) FROM ( select psp.id, psp.process_id as "processId", psp.process_step_id as "processStepId", ps.company_id as "companyId", psp.display_order as "displayOrder", psp.initial_step as "initialStep", psp.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", psp.org_id as "orgId", o.org_name as "orgName", psp.date_created as "dateCreated", psp.created_by_id as "createdById", psp.date_modified as "dateModified", psp.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", psp.archived, ps.process_step_name as "processStepName" from flow.process_step_process psp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psp.process_step_id left join flow.org o on o.id = psp.org_id left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = psp.company_process_step_status_type_id where psp.process_id = p.id and psp.archived is not true order by psp.display_order, ps.process_step_name) processSteps), '[]') AS "processStepProcesses" from flow.company_process cp inner join flow.process p on p.id = cp.process_id where company_id = :companyId and process_id = :processId order by p.process_name;
sql.process.delete: update flow.process set archived = true where id = :processId
sql.process.deleteCompanyProcess: update flow.company_process set archived = true where process_id = :processId and company_id = :companyId
sql.process.update: update flow.process set process_name = :processName, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.process.insertCompanyProcess: insert into flow.company_process (company_id, process_id, status_type_id) values (:companyId, :processId, :statusTypeId)
sql.process.deleteProcessStepFromProcess: update flow.process_step_process set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :processStepProcessId
sql.process.availableProcessSteps: select ps.* from flow.process_step ps where ps.archived is not true and ps.company_id = :companyId and not exists ( select process_step_id from flow.process_step_process psp where psp.process_step_id = ps.id and psp.process_id = :processId and archived is not true ) order by ps.process_step_name
sql.process.insertProcessStepProcess: insert into flow.process_step_process (process_id, process_step_id, org_id, created_by_id, date_created, display_order) values (:processId, :processStepId, :orgId, :createdById, now(), 0)
sql.process.updateProcessStepProcess: update flow.process_step_process set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.process.getInitialProcessStepProcesses: select psp.id, psp.process_id as "processId", psp.process_step_id as "processStepId", ps.company_id as "companyId", psp.display_order as "displayOrder", psp.initial_step as "initialStep", psp.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", psp.org_id as "orgId", o.org_name as "orgName", psp.date_created as "dateCreated", psp.created_by_id as "createdById", psp.date_modified as "dateModified", psp.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", psp.archived, ps.process_step_name as "processStepName" from flow.process_step_process psp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psp.process_step_id left join flow.org o on o.id = psp.org_id left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on psst.id = psp.company_process_step_status_type_id where psp.process_id = :processId and psp.archived is not true and psp.initial_step is true order by psp.display_order, ps.process_step_name
sql.process.setInitialProcessStep: update flow.process_step_process set initial_step = :initialStep, company_process_step_status_type_id = :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :processStepProcessId;
sql.process.getOneProcessStepProcess: select psp.id, psp.process_id as "processId", psp.process_step_id as "processStepId", ps.company_id as "companyId", psp.org_id as "orgId", o.org_name as "orgName", psp.date_created as "dateCreated", psp.created_by_id as "createdById", psp.date_modified as "dateModified", psp.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", psp.display_order as "displayOrder", psp.initial_step as "initialStep", psp.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", psp.archived, ps.process_step_name as "processStepName" from flow.process_step_process psp inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psp.process_step_id left join flow.org o on o.id = psp.org_id left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on psst.id = psp.company_process_step_status_type_id where psp.id = :id
